title: Global economic cost of invasive species (billion dollars/year)

source.name: Invasive Alien Species Assessment
source.publisher: IPBES (Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services)

notes: IPBES's 2023 assessment (86 researchers, 49 countries) found the global cost of invasive species exceeded $423 billion in 2019 and has at least quadrupled every decade since 1970. Intermediate decade points are a reconstruction of that quadrupling claim anchored on the real 2019 total.
